passage.label: Occurrence occurs no denial; bring down raise up; earth shaken convulsion; mountains broken crumbling dust dispersing; three kinds; companions right what right; companions left what left; forerunners forerunners brought near Gardens Pleasure; company former few later; thrones woven reclining facing; circulate young boys eternal vessels pitchers cup flowing spring no headache nor intoxicated; fruit select meat fowl desire; fair women large eyes pearls protected reward used do; not hear ill speech sin only saying peace peace

arabicExcerpts.text: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا

mainSubject.label: The Occurrence declared undeniable when it occurs, bringing some down and raising others while the earth convulses and mountains crumble into dispersing dust; humanity divided into three kinds — companions of the right, companions of the left, and the forerunners who are brought near in Gardens of Pleasure, a large company of former peoples and few of later ones; enthroned on woven seats facing one another, served by eternal youths with vessels, pitchers and cups from a flowing spring causing neither headache nor intoxication; selected fruit and desired fowl-meat provided alongside fair large-eyed women likened to protected pearls as reward for deeds; no ill speech or sin heard there, only the greeting of peace repeated

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the peace-only speech of the forerunners (26) before the companions-of-the-right block opens (27); P2 ends with the Zaqqum accommodation verdict (56) before the four evidentiary challenges begin (57); P3 runs through seed, sowing, water and fire to the first exaltation command (57-74); P4 covers the star-oath, protected Register, deathbed scene, threefold outcome and the closing exaltation (75-96).
